content:
rachel: Heads-up  co-hosted DevSummit mini-workshop with NebulaCloud + EdgeForge on Sep 28. Need speaker list, a touchless kiosk swag flow, and a compact demo fallback ladder. Who can pick owners?
emmett: I can run speaker confirmations and collect 1-line bios. Final names by Mon EOD pls.
jorge: I'll own demo ops. Primary: NebulaCloud private endpoint. Fallback: local CPU container that boots in <45s, then a 90s recorded clip. Also prepping a CLI fallback script.
nina: Marketing: will need headshots + blurbs by Thu. I'll build landing page with CTA + a micro sign-up for live demo slots.
ops-bot: calendar: "DevSummit: NebulaCloud + EdgeForge Workshop" Sep 28 11:00-11:45 PT. Dry run Sep 26 09:00 PT.
rachel: Swag idea: "TapStation" kiosk (touchless). Registrants get a one-time QR; scanning at kiosk triggers a mechanical release. No lines, trackable redemptions. Agree to 1-per-reg?
emmett: 1-per-reg yes. We should add a small promo card inside each pack with a short signup QR to tie conversions.
jorge: Draft manifest (will add weights/dims):
```
- 110 sticker sleeves
- 40 USB-C demo dongles (preloaded)
- 25 pocket dev kits
- 120 quickstart one-pagers
```
nina: Volunteer shifts: 10:30-11:15 lead @jorge, 11:15-12:00 backup @emmett. NebulaCloud will provide an engineer for the first 30m.
rachel: Fallback script for moderator: 1) try Nebula endpoint 2) switch to local container (announce switch) 3) if still failing, play 90s clip + Q&A. Keep transitions under 60s.
ops-bot: reminder: Dry run Sep 26 09:00 PT. Auto-invite sent to panelists.
emmett: Legal/PR note: avoid absolute latency/cost numbers unless cleared. Use qualitative phrasing.
rachel: Final checklist: speakers + bios by Mon, manifest + weights by Fri, slides by Sep 18, dry run Sep 26. I'll DM owners a compact checklist. Thanks all :rocket:
